title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
title_zh: MetaEncoder：探索双编码器在多模态系统一决策中的极限——基于自然语言接口

paragraphs.en: System One models output constrained decisions and probability distributions rather than free-form text generation. While prevailing paradigms rely on structured schema objects to encode state, intent, and candidate choices, we revisit a fully natural language-based System One interface. In this framework, both the user request and each candidate option are expressed in natural language, supported by multimodal (image and video) auxiliary inputs. We introduce MetaEncoder, which fine-tunes a pre-trained Muse-Glimmer 30B decoder into an instruction-following decision-making encoder. To scale effectively across both small closed-set (¡ 256) and massive open-set (millions) candidate spaces, MetaEncoder employs a bi-encoder architecture trained via unidirectional contrastive learning for request-candidate alignment. We conduct extensive evaluations across 11 benchmark suites and 190 tasks spanning multimodal decision-making, understanding (closed-set) and retrieval (open-set), highlighting where MetaEncoder beats SOTA multimodal encoders, as well as its current limits on reasoning-intensive tasks.
paragraphs.zh: System One 模型生成受约束的决策和概率分布，而非自由形式的文本。 尽管现有范式依赖结构化模式对象来编码状态、意图和候选选项，但我们重新探索了一种完全基于自然语言的 System One 接口。 在此框架中，用户请求和每个候选选项均以自然语言表达，并由多模态（图像和视频）辅助输入提供支持。 我们提出了 MetaEncoder，它将预训练的 Muse-Glimmer 30B 解码器微调为一种遵循指令的决策编码器。 为了在小规模封闭集合（<256）和大规模开放集合（数百万）候选空间中实现有效扩展，MetaEncoder 采用了一种双编码器架构，通过单向对比学习进行训练，以实现请求与候选选项的对齐。 我们在 11 个基准套件和 190 项任务上进行了广泛评估，这些任务涵盖多模态决策、理解（封闭集合）和检索（开放集合），并重点展示了 MetaEncoder 在哪些方面优于当前最先进的多模态编码器，以及其在推理密集型任务中的现有局限性。

paragraphs.en: There is a recent trend of repurposing general-purpose encoders as System One models for decision making ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . An encoder-only model answers fast and in a constrained form. It returns a choice among candidates, together with a probability distribution over them, instead of generating free-form text. Many production decisions fit this form: routing a request to an agent, selecting a tool, classifying content against a policy, ranking items, picking the next action in an environment, or retrieving a memory. For these, a calibrated score over candidates from a single forward pass is more useful than a generated answer.
paragraphs.zh: 近期出现了一种趋势，即将通用编码器重新用作决策的“系统一”模型（TypeSafe AI，2026）。 仅包含编码器的模型能够以受限的形式快速给出答案。 它会从多个候选项中返回一个选择，并附带这些候选项的概率分布，而不是生成自由形式的文本。 许多实际决策都符合这种形式：将请求路由到某个智能体、选择工具、根据策略对内容进行分类、对项目进行排序、在环境中选择下一步行动，或检索记忆。 对于这些任务而言，通过单次前向传播获得的候选项校准得分比生成的答案更有用。

paragraphs.en: Encoder models that score candidates are not a new topic. First, sentence-BERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) and dense retrievers ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) popularized bi-encoders . These embed a query and a candidate independently and compare them by vector similarity, and they were later scaled into universal text embedders ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . In vision, two-tower models such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) align images with texts through contrastive learning. More recently, multimodal embedders built on vision-language backbones cast classification, question answering, and grounding as retrieval over candidates ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Second, Cross-encoders ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Nogueira et al., 2020 ) instead encode the query and the candidate together, trading efficiency for accuracy, and remain the standard choice for reranking. Finally, constrained decoders can also score candidates directly. The options are listed in the prompt under identifiers (A, B, C, …), and the model picks the identifier with the highest next-token probability ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Robinson et al., 2023 ; Gangi Reddy et al., 2024 ) . This model compares all options jointly, but the candidate cardinality is bounded by the context window and results are sensitive to option order ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We review all above work in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为候选项评分的编码器模型并非一个新话题。 首先，sentence-BERT（Reimers and Gurevych, 2019）和密集检索器（Karpukhin et al., 2020）推广了双编码器。 这些模型独立地嵌入查询和候选项，并通过向量相似度进行比较，后来它们被扩展为通用文本嵌入器（Wang et al., 2022；Xiao et al., 2024；Su et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2024）。 在视觉领域，像 CLIP（Radford et al., 2021）这样的双塔模型通过对比学习将图像与文本对齐。 近期，基于视觉-语言骨干网络的多模态嵌入器将分类、问答和定位问题转化为对候选项的检索（Jiang et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 其次，交叉编码器（Nogueira and Cho, 2019；Nogueira et al., 2020）则将查询和候选项一起编码，以牺牲效率为代价换取更高的准确性，并且仍然是重排序的标准选择。 最后，受约束的解码器也可以直接对候选项进行评分。 这些选项在提示中以标识符（A、B、C、…）列出，模型会选择具有最高下一个词元概率的标识符（Hendrycks et al., 2021；Robinson et al., 2023；Gangi Reddy et al., 2024）。 该模型会联合比较所有选项，但候选项的数量受上下文窗口限制，且结果对选项顺序敏感（Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024；Zheng et al., 2024）。 我们在第 2 节中回顾了上述所有工作。

paragraphs.en: When such a model is repurposed as a System One model, a common interface is a structured request object . It contains separate fields for the context or state, the questions or instructions, the options and scoring criteria, and each task has its own schema. Schemas are precise, but they are rigid. In this work we revisit a fully natural-language interface. The prompt is free-form text, optionally with images or video, that describes the state, the instruction, and the criteria for the task. The output stays constrained to a set of candidate options, each of which is also described in natural language. Our goal is a general-purpose encoder that follows instructions and makes decisions, similar to prompting a decoder-only model.
paragraphs.zh: 当此类模型被重新用作“系统一”模型时，一种常见的接口是结构化请求对象。 它包含用于上下文或状态、问题或指令、选项和评分标准的独立字段，且每个任务都有自身的数据模式。 数据模式虽然精确，但缺乏灵活性。 在本项工作中，我们重新探讨了一种完全基于自然语言的接口。 提示词是自由形式的文本，可选地包含图片或视频，用于描述任务的状态、指令和标准。 输出结果仍被限制在一组候选选项之中，每个选项同样以自然语言进行描述。 我们的目标是构建一个通用编码器，能够遵循指令并做出决策，类似于对仅含解码器的模型进行提示。

paragraphs.en: A key consideration in choosing the encoder architecture is balancing efficiency against scalability. Scalability here means both the number of candidates that can be scored and whether candidate representations can be cached. Cross-encoders and constrained decoders are powerful because the request attends to candidates directly. However, they cannot cache efficiently, so they do not scale to large candidate sets. Bi-encoders encode candidates independently of the request. This makes the candidate cardinality scale from a closed set of ¡256 options to millions of items. However, the price is that all interaction between request and candidate passes through a single vector. Whether that bottleneck can still support instruction generalization is an open question. In this work we revisit bi-encoders and explore how far they can go as general-purpose, instruction-following encoders. Empirically, we demonstrate that bi-encoders can also achieve high accuracy in closed-set decision-making by incorporating candidate options directly into the request’s prompt, supplying the model with information equivalent to that of a constrained decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 在选择编码器架构时，一个关键考量是平衡效率与可扩展性。 此处的可扩展性既指可评分的候选项数量，也指候选项表示是否可以缓存。 交叉编码器和受约束解码器之所以强大，是因为请求可以直接关注候选项。 然而，它们无法高效缓存，因此无法扩展到大型候选项集合。 双编码器将候选项独立于请求进行编码。 这使得候选项的数量可以从一个包含 ¡256 个选项的封闭集合扩展到数百万个条目。 然而，其代价是请求与候选项之间的所有交互都必须通过单个向量完成。 这种瓶颈是否仍能支持指令泛化，目前仍是一个开放问题。 在本研究中，我们重新审视了双编码器，并探索了它们作为通用指令跟随编码器的潜力边界。 通过实证研究，我们证明，双编码器也可以通过将候选选项直接融入请求提示中，从而在封闭集决策任务中实现高精度，这为模型提供了与受约束解码器相当的信息。

paragraphs.en: We train MetaEncoder , a general-purpose multimodal encoder for instruction-following decision making, understanding and retrieval. MetaEncoder fine-tunes a pre-trained Muse-Glimmer ( Meta Superintelligence Lab, 2026 ) 30B decoder into an encoder. For training, MetaEncoder adopts unidirectional contrastive learning to align each request with its target candidate, differentiating closed- and open-set problems through the negative selection strategy (i.e., using a provided option list vs. gathering across all devices). For inference, the same model handles small closed sets of fewer than 256 options and open corpora of millions of candidates, which differ only in how the request prompt is constructed. MetaEncoder adopts the natural-language interface described above, so users interact with it similar to a decoder-only LLM. Both the request and the candidates can be multimodal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练了 MetaEncoder，这是一种用于指令跟随决策、理解和检索的通用多模态编码器。 MetaEncoder 将预训练的 Muse-Glimmer（Meta Superintelligence Lab，2026）30B 解码器微调为编码器。 在训练阶段，MetaEncoder 采用单向对比学习，使每个请求与其目标候选项对齐，并通过负样本选择策略区分闭集和开集问题（即使用提供的选项列表与从所有设备中收集数据）。 在推理阶段，同一模型可处理少于 256 个选项的小型闭集以及包含数百万候选项的开域语料库，二者的区别仅在于请求提示的构建方式。 MetaEncoder 采用上述描述的自然语言接口，因此用户与其交互的方式类似于与仅含解码器的 LLM 交互。 请求和候选项都可以是多模态的。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MetaEncoder across 11 benchmark suites comprising 190 tasks. These span closed-set multimodal decision-making and understanding (JevBench ( Standhartinger and Contributors, 2026 ) , ImaJevBench ( Mohit and Contributors, 2026 ) , MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , VideoMMMU ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , NaturalBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024 ) ) as well as open-corpus retrieval (NanoBEIR ( AI, 2025 ) , MMEB-v3 image, video, and visdoc ( Huang et al., 2026 ) ). MetaEncoder outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal embedding models ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) on all decision-making tasks while achieving near-SOTA results on multimodal retrieval benchmarks which is beyond the scope of Jev models ( Wortega and Contributors, 2026 ) . On the other hand, we also identify the inherent limitations of bi-encoder architectures on complex decision-making tasks relative to decoders, where the lack of explicit reasoning capabilities remains the primary bottleneck.

Classification, retrieval routing, reranking, and judgment all fit this one interface. They differ only in where the candidate set comes from: a global corpus, a fixed label space, or a set defined by each example, as in Jev-style tasks where every row carries its own options and criteria. Later work added instructions to the input ( Su et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; BehnamGhader et al., 2024 ) and extended the recipe to multimodal inputs using vision-language backbones ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and augmenting encoder input with reasoning ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Lan et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Benchmarks such as MTEB ( Muennighoff et al., 2023 ) and MMEB ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) already cast classification, VQA, and grounding as ranking over candidates. Broadly, a model built on a language-model backbone can score candidates in 3 ways. They differ in how much the prompt and the candidates interact, and therefore in cost, scalability, and expressiveness:

paragraphs.en: (1) Bi-encoders. A bi-encoder embeds the prompt (instruction, state, context, etc.) and each candidate separately and scores them by cosine similarity. It is trained with a CLIP-style contrastive objective that pulls the prompt toward its gold candidate and pushes it away from in-batch or hard negatives ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; van den Oord et al., 2018 ) . This is the dominant design for universal embedders ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Su et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Its main advantage is efficiency: since candidate embeddings do not depend on the prompt, they can be precomputed and indexed. Scoring K K candidates then costs a single prompt forward pass plus K K dot products, and this scales to candidates of millions. However, the tradeoff lies in expressiveness: since all interaction happens through a single dot product, the prompt embedding must anticipate every candidate it might be compared against. This is a known weakness on fine-grained or compositional distinctions ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Thrush et al., 2022 ) . It is especially limiting when what a label means is defined by the prompt itself, for example by row-specific criteria, since the candidate embedding cannot see those criteria. Late-interaction models such as ColBERT ( Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ) relax the single-vector bottleneck but still encode the two sides independently.
paragraphs.zh: 双编码器。 双编码器将提示（指令、状态、上下文等）和每个候选项分别嵌入，并通过余弦相似度对它们进行评分。 它采用类似 CLIP 的对比目标进行训练，该目标将提示向其正确候选项拉近，同时将其推离批次内的负样本或困难负样本（Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; van den Oord et al., 2018）。 这是通用嵌入模型的主流设计（Wang et al., 2022 ; Su et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a）。 其主要优势在于效率：由于候选项的嵌入不依赖于提示，因此可以预先计算并建立索引。 随后对 K 个候选项进行评分仅需一次提示前向传播和 K 次点积运算，这种方案可扩展至数百万个候选项。 然而，其权衡之处在于表达能力：由于所有交互都通过单个点积完成，提示嵌入必须能够预测它可能与之比较的每一个候选项。 这在细粒度或组合性区分任务中是一个已知的弱点（Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Thrush et al., 2022）。 当标签的含义由提示本身定义时，这种设计尤其受限，例如通过行特定的标准定义，因为候选项嵌入无法感知这些标准。 晚期交互模型（如 ColBERT (Khattab and Zaharia, 2020)）缓解了单向量瓶颈，但仍然对两个部分进行独立编码。

paragraphs.en: (2) Cross-encoders. A cross-encoder concatenates the prompt with one candidate at a time. A shared transformer processes the pair jointly, and a scalar relevance score is read from a classification head or from the logit of a yes/true token ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Nogueira et al., 2020 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Full token-level attention between prompt and candidate makes cross-encoders consistently more accurate than bi-encoders. That is why they serve as the second-stage reranker in retrieve-then-rerank pipelines ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . LLM-as-a-judge pointwise scoring follows the same pattern ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Two costs follow from the design: First, nothing can be cached: scoring K K candidates takes K K full forward passes over the shared prompt. Second, each candidate is scored in isolation, so the model never compares candidates directly. Scores must be calibrated across independent passes, and the model cannot use the structure of the option set (none of the above, mutually exclusive labels, near-duplicate options) to decide.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 跨编码器。 跨编码器每次将提示与一个候选项拼接处理。 共享变换器对这对输入进行联合处理，并通过分类头或“是/真”标记的 logits 读取标量相关性得分（Nogueira and Cho, 2019；Nogueira et al., 2020；Ma et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025b）。 提示与候选项之间的完整词元级注意力机制使得跨编码器始终比双编码器更准确。 因此，它们在“检索-再排序”流程中用作第二阶段的重排序器（Nogueira and Cho, 2019；Xiao et al., 2024；Cui et al., 2025）。 LLM-as-a-judge 的点式评分遵循相同的模式（Zheng et al., 2023）。 这种设计带来了两种成本：首先，无法进行任何缓存：为 K 个候选项打分需要在共享提示上执行 K 次完整的正向传播。 其次，每个候选项都是独立评分的，因此模型从未直接比较过候选项。 得分必须通过独立的传播过程进行校准，且模型无法利用选项集的结构（如“以上都不是”、“互斥标签”或“近重复选项”）来做出判断。

sents.en: LLM-as-a-judge pointwise scoring follows the same pattern ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .

sents.en: Two costs follow from the design: First, nothing can be cached: scoring K K candidates takes K K full forward passes over the shared prompt.
sents.zh: 这种设计带来了两种成本：首先，无法进行任何缓存：为 K 个候选项打分需要在共享提示上执行 K 次完整的正向传播。

sents.en: Second, each candidate is scored in isolation, so the model never compares candidates directly.
sents.zh: 其次，每个候选项都是独立评分的，因此模型从未直接比较过候选项。

sents.en: Scores must be calibrated across independent passes, and the model cannot use the structure of the option set (none of the above, mutually exclusive labels, near-duplicate options) to decide.
sents.zh: 得分必须通过独立的传播过程进行校准，且模型无法利用选项集的结构（如“以上都不是”、“互斥标签”或“近重复选项”）来做出判断。

paragraphs.en: (3) One-step constrained decoding. The third approach puts the instruction, the context, and all candidates into a single prompt. Each candidate is labeled with an identifier (A, B, …, Z), and a generative model is asked to emit one identifier token. The prediction is the argmax of the next-token distribution restricted to the valid identifiers. Since the vocabulary projection can be pruned to constrain outputs, the approach acts as a cheap encoder prefilling pass topped with a light linear decision layer. This is the standard multiple-choice format for evaluating LLMs ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Robinson et al., 2023 ) . It underlies zero-shot classification through verbalizers ( Schick and Schütze, 2021 ) and has been adopted for listwise reranking, where the first generated identifier’s logits act as the ranking score ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Gangi Reddy et al., 2024 ) . Because all candidates share one context, the model can compare them jointly. Inference takes a single forward pass regardless of K K , and no new head or training objective is needed beyond the language-modeling loss. On the other hand, the limitations come from treating candidates as tokens in a sequence. Accuracy is sensitive to option order and identifier choice ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . The candidate set is bounded by the size of the identifier alphabet and by the context window, so the approach cannot support large candidates. Besides, the output is a distribution over positions, but not a reusable representation of the candidates. As a result, nothing can be indexed, cached across prompts, or reused for retrieval and clustering.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 单步约束解码。 第三种方法将指令、上下文和所有候选项整合到单个提示中。 每个候选项都标有一个标识符（A、B、…、Z），并要求生成模型输出一个标识符标记。 预测结果是对有效标识符进行限制后的下一个标记分布的 argmax。 由于词汇表投影可以通过剪枝来约束输出，这种方法相当于一个廉价的编码器预填充步骤，其顶部叠加了一个轻量级的线性决策层。 这是评估 LLM 的标准选择题格式（Hendrycks 等，2021；Robinson 等，2023）。 它构成了通过 verbalizer 实现的零样本分类的基础（Schick 和 Schütze，2021），并已被用于列表重排序，其中第一个生成标识符的 logits 用作排序分数（Sun 等，2023；Gangi Reddy 等，2024）。 由于所有候选项共享同一个上下文，模型可以对其进行联合比较。 无论 K 的大小如何，推理过程只需一次前向传播，除了语言建模损失之外，无需引入新的模型头或训练目标。 另一方面，其局限性源于将候选项视为序列中的标记。 准确率对选项顺序和标识符的选择较为敏感（Pezeshkpour 和 Hruschka，2024；Zheng 等，2024）。 候选项集的大小受限于标识符字母表的大小和上下文窗口，因此该方法无法支持大型候选项。 此外，输出是对位置的分布，而非候选项的可复用表示。 因此，无法对任何内容进行索引、跨提示缓存，或用于检索和聚类。

paragraphs.en: Summary. The three designs trade off along one axis: how much the prompt and the candidates interact. Bi-encoders allow none interactions, which buys indexing and scale. Cross-encoders let the prompt interact with each candidate individually, which buys accuracy at O ⁡ ( K ) O(K) cost and no representation caching. Constrained generation lets all candidates interact with each other and with the prompt in one pass, but it gives up open-ended candidate sets and reusable embeddings completely. In this work, we adopt a cachable bi-encoder design to explore its limit in general-purpose decision making.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 这三种设计在一个维度上存在权衡：提示词与候选项之间的交互程度。 双编码器不允许任何交互，从而实现了索引和可扩展性。 跨编码器允许提示词与每个候选项单独交互，以 O(K) 的成本获得更高的准确性，但无法进行表示缓存。 受约束生成允许所有候选项在一次处理中相互交互并与提示词交互，但这完全放弃了开放式的候选项集和可重用的嵌入表示。 在本研究中，我们采用了一种可缓存的双编码器设计，以探索其在通用决策中的极限。

paragraphs.en: MetaEncoder scores a set of candidates 𝒞 = { c 1 , … , c K } \mathcal{C}=\{c_{1},\dots,c_{K}\} against a request q q . paragraphs.en: ImaJEV-Bench ( Mohit and Contributors, 2026 ) extends the Jev format to multimodal states. It has 173 dev entries in three subsets. paragraphs.en: The results of MetaEncoder demonstrates that a unified bi-encoder architecture can effectively master both multimodal decision-making and retrieval tasks. On decision-making and multimodal multiple-choice understanding benchmarks, MetaEncoder outperforms current SOTA retrieval models, including WeMM-Embedding-9B, which holds first place on the MMEB-V3 leaderboard ( TIGER-Lab, 2026 ) . However, MetaEncoder slightly lags behind OpenJev-27B in text-only decision-making. OpenJev-27B is a SOTA System One model that jointly encodes the request and all options using a single backbone paired with a decision scoring head. We attribute this performance gap to the structural differences between bi-encoders and full-attention models, reflecting the classic tradeoff between bi-encoder caching efficiency and cross-encoder ranking accuracy. However, OpenJev-27B does not have the ability for retrieval tasks nor multimodal tasks.
paragraphs.zh: MetaEncoder 的结果表明，统一的双编码器架构能够有效掌握多模态决策和检索任务。 在决策和多模态多选理解基准测试中，MetaEncoder 的表现优于当前的 SOTA 检索模型，包括在 MMEB-V3 排行榜上排名第一的 WeMM-Embedding-9B（TIGER-Lab, 2026）。 然而，在纯文本决策任务中，MetaEncoder 的表现略逊于 OpenJev-27B。 OpenJev-27B 是一款 SOTA System One 模型，它通过单个主干网络搭配决策评分头，联合编码请求和所有选项。 我们将这一性能差距归因于双编码器和全注意力模型在结构上的差异，这反映了双编码器缓存效率与跨编码器排序准确性之间的经典权衡。 然而，OpenJev-27B 不具备执行检索任务或多模态任务的能力。

sents.en: The results of MetaEncoder demonstrates that a unified bi-encoder architecture can effectively master both multimodal decision-making and retrieval tasks.
sents.zh: MetaEncoder 的结果表明，统一的双编码器架构能够有效掌握多模态决策和检索任务。

sents.en: On decision-making and multimodal multiple-choice understanding benchmarks, MetaEncoder outperforms current SOTA retrieval models, including WeMM-Embedding-9B, which holds first place on the MMEB-V3 leaderboard ( TIGER-Lab, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在决策和多模态多选理解基准测试中，MetaEncoder 的表现优于当前的 SOTA 检索模型，包括在 MMEB-V3 排行榜上排名第一的 WeMM-Embedding-9B（TIGER-Lab, 2026）。

sents.en: However, MetaEncoder slightly lags behind OpenJev-27B in text-only decision-making.
sents.zh: 然而，在纯文本决策任务中，MetaEncoder 的表现略逊于 OpenJev-27B。

sents.en: OpenJev-27B is a SOTA System One model that jointly encodes the request and all options using a single backbone paired with a decision scoring head.
sents.zh: OpenJev-27B 是一款 SOTA System One 模型，它通过单个主干网络搭配决策评分头，联合编码请求和所有选项。

sents.en: We attribute this performance gap to the structural differences between bi-encoders and full-attention models, reflecting the classic tradeoff between bi-encoder caching efficiency and cross-encoder ranking accuracy.
sents.zh: 我们将这一性能差距归因于双编码器和全注意力模型在结构上的差异，这反映了双编码器缓存效率与跨编码器排序准确性之间的经典权衡。

sents.en: However, OpenJev-27B does not have the ability for retrieval tasks nor multimodal tasks.
sents.zh: 然而，OpenJev-27B 不具备执行检索任务或多模态任务的能力。

paragraphs.en: Bi-encoders encode requests and candidates independently, computing scores via inner product instead of cross-attention. This architecture is effective when candidates are semantically distinct, but multiple-choice benchmarks frequently present options differing by a single attribute—such as "red, oxidative, slow contracting" versus "red, oxidative, fast contracting" . To equip the encoder with a global picture of what candidates are available, one solution we adopt is to put the option list directly into the request if the cardinality is small. In this ablation study, we compare evaluation results with and without the options in the prompt. The ablation is conducted on MMLU and MMMU.
paragraphs.zh: 双编码器独立地对请求和候选项进行编码，通过内积而非交叉注意力计算得分。 当候选项在语义上存在显著差异时，这种架构是有效的；但多项选择题基准测试中，选项往往仅因单一属性而不同——例如“红色、氧化性、收缩缓慢”与“红色、氧化性、收缩迅速”。 为了让编码器能够全面掌握可用的候选项，我们采用的一个解决方案是：如果选项数量较少，则直接将选项列表嵌入到请求中。 在此消融研究中，我们比较了提示中包含和不包含选项时的评估结果。 该消融研究在 MMLU 和 MMMU 上进行了实施。

sents.zh: 双编码器独立地对请求和候选项进行编码，通过内积而非交叉注意力计算得分。

sents.en: This architecture is effective when candidates are semantically distinct, but multiple-choice benchmarks frequently present options differing by a single attribute—such as "red, oxidative, slow contracting" versus "red, oxidative, fast contracting" .

sents.en: To equip the encoder with a global picture of what candidates are available, one solution we adopt is to put the option list directly into the request if the cardinality is small.
sents.zh: 为了让编码器能够全面掌握可用的候选项，我们采用的一个解决方案是：如果选项数量较少，则直接将选项列表嵌入到请求中。

sents.en: In this ablation study, we compare evaluation results with and without the options in the prompt.
sents.zh: 在此消融研究中，我们比较了提示中包含和不包含选项时的评估结果。

sents.en: The ablation is conducted on MMLU and MMMU.
sents.zh: 该消融研究在 MMLU 和 MMMU 上进行了实施。

We find that appending option lists to request yields substantial, uniform gains : performance improves across 56 of 57 MMLU subjects and 27 of 30 MMMU subjects. These gains are more significant on text-only benchmarks than on multimodal ones.

paragraphs.en: Recommendation : Always append option list to the request for smaller candidate pool.
paragraphs.zh: 建议：始终在请求后附加选项列表，以缩小候选池范围。

paragraphs.en: In bi-encoders the candidate string is the entire signal on the candidate side and the only interaction between a request-candidate pair is an inner product between the two vectors. In this section, we measures the impact of the candidate-side format to the final result.
